dataList.content:
How are classes going, Xichun?
你有在认真听课吗，惜春？
dataList.place:
Daguanyuan - Special Lecture Hall
大观园 特殊教室

dataList.content:
Hmph. I'm not you, big bro. I pay attention in class.
哼，当我是哥哥那样的人吗？我有在好好听啦。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
Oh hello, Miss Daiyu!
黛玉小姐也和我们一起吗？

Fuhu, she was really insistent on helping me out, even though I refused because she looked preoccupied.
呼呼，我看她很忙的样子，就说没关系来着，结果她还是坚持要帮忙呢。

... The moment I found out about the contents of his lesson plan, I simply could not allow him to do this alone.
……既然已经看过那堂课的内容，就不能让宝玉哥哥自己去了。
dataList.title:
Daguanyuan
大观园

dataList.content:
<Looks like it's going to be another serious class...>
<看来又是一堂不简单的课呢……>

Ah! Apologies for the delayed greetings. Daiyu of the Lin family formally extends her greetings to the venerable Hierarch.
啊！失礼了。林家黛玉，拜见家主大人。
dataList.title:
Daguanyuan
大观园

dataList.content:
... Been a while since I heard that greeting around here.
……这样的问候，似乎是这几天来头一回听到。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
Wait, what about big sis Baochai? Are you sure it's okay for a Xue family bodyguard to be here?
说起来，宝钗姐姐呢？你作为薛家的护卫到这里来没关系吗？
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
Ah... I am no longer employed as Miss Baochai's guard.
啊……我已不再是宝钗小姐的侍卫了。
dataList.title:
Daguanyuan
大观园

dataList.content:
W-wait, don't tell me we got you f—
不、不会是因为我们才……

Everything I did that day, including accompanying you, was... under Miss Baochai's orders.
之前与各位同行全部都是……宝钗小姐的命令。
dataList.title:
Daguanyuan
大观园

dataList.content:
As for why she no longer needed my services, I... don't understand myself. She suddenly let me go after the trouble was over.
至于驱逐我的理由……我也不是很清楚。那场骚乱结束后，她就突然把我赶走了。
dataList.title:
Daguanyuan
大观园

The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
So... what's there for you to teach me, big bro? Your last lesson plan about not making things awkward got vetoed by Zilu, so...
所以……哥哥要教我什么呢？上次提到的那个可以巧妙化解的办法，已经全部被子路处理掉了。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
You could've taught me a thing or two if we were still kids, but... come on, you spent most of your time stuck in Yihongyuan before leaving Hongyuan. I don't know what you could possibly have to teach me.
要说小时候……还能另当别论，可我就是不明白那个一直窝在怡红院然后又离开了鸿园的哥哥……到底哪里比我强啊？
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
Hehe... don't you worry, Xichun. This is the one thing I think I'm pretty good at.
呼呼……别担心，惜春。我在这方面还是相当有自信的，不会让你失望的。

My lesson for Xichun and Sinclair is...
我为惜春和辛克莱先生准备的课程是……

In clear, neat handwriting, Hong Lu wrote "Surviving Hongyuan" on the chalkboard.
鸿璐用工整的字迹在黑板上写下“鸿园生存指南”。

Oh, well. I don't think I need any help in that department from you.
这方面我也和哥哥一样有自信就是了。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
Look, I... know you've had your share of assassination attempts, big bro. But Jia Mu—I mean, the previous Hierarch and the elders' favor sheltered you from the worst of it.
哥哥你……确实也受过不少阴谋诡计的算计……但坐拥贾母……前任家主和长辈们的宠爱，情况要稍微好些吧。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
S-she's not wrong. Back when we had to fight our way through a bunch of Sweepers, weren't you also one of the handful who got assassinated?
说、说起来和清道夫战斗的那天也是……对你的暗杀似乎很轻易就得手了……

Oh, that? I was wandering the hallways because I felt like something was off about my room.
那天我感觉待在房间里不太妙，于是就去了另一条走廊。

Until Dante told us all to go back to our rooms, of course~
但丁阁下让所有人都回房间去我才回去的~

<W-wait, it was my fault!?>
<是、是我的错吗！？>

You do have some intuition, I'll give you that...
直觉……确实挺准呢。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
Looks like I'm going to have to prove myself.
看来有必要证明一下呢。
Daiyu, would you mind preparing the thing? 黛玉，可以帮我准备一下“那个”吗？

... You have my utmost faith, but... please, do practice caution.
……我并不是不信任宝玉哥哥，但还是请务必要小心。
dataList.title:
Daguanyuan
大观园

dataList.content:
Some time later, Lin Daiyu appeared with four bowls splishing with tea, before sprinkling some powder into one of them.
不久之后，林黛玉在桌上摆开了四只装着茶水的碗，然后开始往其中一个碗里撒下粉末。

What's that...?
那是……？

That's powdered wolfsbane. I see where this is going.
那粉末是乌头的毒吧。我明白你想干什么了。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
You're going to teach me how to tell which of these bowls contain poison, right? You can stop now. I learned to recognize infamous poisons like wolfsbane when I was seven—
分辨哪个碗里的液体有毒的办法。反正，你就是想说这个吧？这种分辨有名毒药的方法，我七岁的时候就已经……
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
If it was something as tame as what you are suggesting, venerable Hierarch... haah... I would not have been here to accompany him.
若是如家主大人所言，是那样温和的课程的话……哈啊……就算我不同行也没关系的。
dataList.title:
Daguanyuan
大观园

dataList.content:
Lin Daiyu continued her process, sprinkling wolfsbane powder into two more bowls. Hong Lu, who was watching that with an oddly contented expression, closed his eyes.
林黛玉没有停下，将乌头的粉末又往另外两个碗里撒了下去，一直在一旁满意地注视着的鸿璐，就这样闭上了双眼。

Please mix them up, Daiyu.
请把它们打乱吧，黛玉。

Okay... wait, what!?
好……啊！？

We stared in confusion, but we could hardly tell what was going on with the speed at which Lin Daiyu swapped around the bowls. When we looked back at Hong Lu, there were three silver spoons in his hand.
就在这时，林黛玉以肉眼不可见的速度将茶碗打乱了顺序，鸿璐也不知什么时候手中握上了三把银色的汤匙。

Those silver spoons were custom-made at Daguanyuan's request; a must-have item for children of the four great houses, they can detect non-sulfuric poison as well.
宝玉哥哥手里的银匙……是大观园特别铸造的定制品。即便是不含硫元素的毒药也能检测出来，是四大家族的富家子弟们的必需品。
dataList.title:
Daguanyuan
大观园

dataList.content:
Yeah, I know. They're actually—ugh.
我认得。原本那就是……呃。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
Actually what...?
是什么……？

It's nothing.
没什么。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
Fuhu, in Hongyuan, where we are beset by threats of assassination from all directions...
呼呼。为了在充斥着暗杀，危机四伏的鸿园中生存下去。

... knowledge alone isn't enough to save you.
仅仅是懂得多还不够。

What the heck are you—
你想干什……
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
But Hong Lu opens his eyes before Jia Xichun can finish her sentence.
还没等贾惜春的话说完。

Then, he throws the silver spoons in his hands like throwing pins toward three of the bowls...
睁开眼的鸿璐，将手中的银匙像匕首一样投入了碗中……

... and immediately chugs the fourth bowl, which he hadn't thrown a spoon at.
紧接着立刻将没有掷入银匙的第四个碗中的茶水一饮而尽。

H-holy crap, are you insane!? You barely even checked them for—!
你、你脑子有问题吗！？不先弄清楚就喝掉的话……！
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
Mmm~ Xiren's nu'er tea is always delicious, even when cooled.
嗯~果然袭人沏的女儿茶就算冷掉了也很好喝呢。

The three silver spoons Hong Lu had cast earlier were slowly melting away after quickly becoming tarnished black.
鸿璐刚才投下的三把银匙，此时已经不仅仅是变得漆黑，甚至开始慢慢溶解了。

Do, uh... is wolfsbane poison supposed to... melt through metal...?
乌头的毒……一般情况下……能腐蚀，金属吗？

People like to be thorough with their poisons in Daguanyuan. Since everyone's been trained for immunity since childhood, you have to make a mixture of various poisons to have a real effect.
大观园的毒，可不会原封不动地拿来使用。因为大家从小时候开始就培养了对毒的耐性，所以必须混合各种各样的毒草才能起效。

Haah...
哈啊……
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
Fine, I don't even wanna argue. What's your secret?
我懒得继续问了。所以，你到底是怎么办到的？
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
I wanna know, too. Do they sound different or something?
我也想问……是声音不一样吗？

Hehe, I just went with my hunch.
呼呼，当然是直觉了。

Just a hunch? How are we supposed to learn that? We're not Heathcliff, you know?
直、直觉吗？我们又不是希斯克利夫先生，要怎么去学那种东西啊！？

You'll get the hang of it after a few tries~
跟我一起多练习几次的话，很快就能学会的哦~

I'll help you out. Shall we begin with two bowls?
先从两个碗开始吧？
